items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: P. John had been with King Oliver and had been in New York and came back.

ctx.x: And, um, P. John had been with King Oliver and had been in New York and came back. And they were going to let, get me to, uh, work in, on this, at this place with this, uh, Alto player. I can't remember his name right now. But anyway, he's a, he was an elder. He would be close to 90 years old now that I was a boy when he, when, you know, when he was grown. And, um, uh, uh, when we went, we rehearsed and we went down to the old Aspen bar, the old Aspen house, to work that night. And, uh, what's the name of the man…
